paragraphs: DEVENTit sells Atlantis, web-based collection management software for managing and presenting archive and heritage collections. The company aims it at various kinds of organizations across the archive and heritage sector.

A management environment brings together the information that collection and application administrators need. A separate public environment makes collections available to the public online. Collection data is kept according to common national and international standards. Tailored modules cover image material, printed sources, deeds and registers, building files, and library collections. Links to third-party systems allow data to be retrieved or sent. Collections can also be shared following the principles of Netwerk Digitaal Erfgoed.

Municipalities use Atlantis to provide information to staff and citizens. Museums use it to manage museum collections. The product is built up in modules. Hosting is mirrored across two separate physical locations in the Netherlands.

quote.text: Atlantis is webbased collectiebeheersoftware voor beheer en presentatie van archief- en erfgoedcollecties.
